# Progress

Latest release: [0.10.0](https://github.com/beyond10x/patchback/releases/tag/0.10.0), 2026-10-25. 41 stories (25 implemented, 2 active, 14 draft).

Patchback is built in the milestones of [DESIGN.md § 13](https://github.com/beyond10x/patchback/blob/main/DESIGN.md#13-delivery-plan-and-decisions). Each milestone is a set of stories, and each story is one change with its own acceptance tests. This page is generated from the project's plan and its [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/beyond10x/patchback/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) whenever the documentation is regenerated.

**Status:** `draft` is planned, `active` is being built, `implemented` is finished and on `main`. **Release:** the newest release whose CHANGELOG entry names the story; "by date" marks a story the CHANGELOG does not name, shown with the first release dated on or after the day it was finished.
